bio: Peninsula roadie — pre-work rides and long climbing weekends. Precise about fit, gearing, and build notes. Looking for serious riders beyond the club.
voice: Precise, data-driven, concise. Speaks in specifics (grades, cassette ranges, stack/reach). No hype; researches before recommending.

garage.title: Trek Émonda race bike

garage.notes: Electronic groupset; Aeolus deep wheels. Fit notes logged separately.
garage.provenance: Bought new after a year of research.

garage.title: Titanium all-road winter bike

garage.title: Wahoo KICKR trainer setup

askTemplates.title: Compatibility check: AXS crank with a titanium BB for winter miles?
askTemplates.body: Winter bike is Ti with a PressFit BB. Wanting to move an AXS crankset over from the race bike without guessing. Anyone run this combo long-term — creak, face issues, or a better BB path?

askTemplates.title: Best climbing cassette for Old La Honda repeats — 10-33 or 10-36 on 1x?
askTemplates.body: Doing a lot of OLH / Page Mill volume. Looking for a cassette that keeps cadence honest on the steepest pitches without spinning out on the descents. Current chainring is 40t.

askTemplates.title: Fair ask on a lightly used deep-section carbon wheelset?
askTemplates.body: Considering selling my aero set locally. Low miles, no crashes, original boxes. What are people actually clearing vs listing in the Bay Area right now?

messageTemplates: Hey — noticed your garage. Curious how you’re documenting fit numbers and build notes. I’m trying to keep stack/reach and component changes in one place.
Quick question from a Peninsula rider: what’s your go-to winter tire pressure on mixed pavement when it’s wet? Trying to settle something for the Ti bike.
